crossRefs.note: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me…
Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him.”
The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him…
He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God…
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…

translations.web: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
translations.bsb: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
translations.kjv: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst
translations.asv: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.
